borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Conversion of the existing side extension into a garage including replacement of the window with a garage door, construction of two front dormer windows and hip-to-gable roof extensions on both sides to accommodate a rear dormer extension to facilitate conversion of roof space into habitable accommodation
decision_conditions: <p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:11pt">The proposed development, by reason of its scale, siting, design, bulk and mass would be an undesirable addition&nbsp;to the existing dwelling. The proposal fails to preserve the existing character of the dwelling and pattern of development. As such, the cumulative impact of the proposal would cause undue harm to the character and appearance of the host dwelling and surrounding area. The proposal is therefore contrary to&nbsp;the following policies which seek to ensure that development recognises local character and promotes good design:&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></p><p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:11pt">- National Planning Policy Framework National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, 2024)<br>- Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021)<br>- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)<br>- Policies SP2, DMD1 and DMD5 of The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037: (September 2024)</span></p>
